# A client's terminal (regressions): it is described with the server's terminal-features and
# terminal-overrides as the config set them (tty_term_create), and its theme colours are worked
# out as it opens (server_client_open), so with RGB the default borders are gray70 and
# yellowgreen at once; the theme option changes them.
conf terminal.conf
size 60x10
run new-session -d -s a 'exec cat' ; split-window -h -t a 'exec cat'
client c 60x10
run list-clients -F '#{client_colours}|#{client_termfeatures}'
screen c
run set -g theme light
screen c
run set -g theme terminal
screen c
run set -g dark-theme-green red ; set -g theme detect
screen c
run kill-server
